name: Flea & Tick Collar for Large Dogs
label: 85 cm, black

size.quote: для собак крупных пород от блох (5 мес.) и клещей (2 мес.) с 6 месяцев - 85 см

texts.about_this_item: Beaphar flea and tick collar for large-breed dogs from 6 months of age, 85 cm, black. Kills parasites and protects against re-infestation by fleas and ticks for 6 months. Part of step 2 of Beaphar's four-step parasite protection programme. The active ingredient diazinon is released from the strap onto the skin and coat and acts on contact against fleas, lice, biting lice and ticks.
texts.feeding_instructions: Fit the collar loosely around the dog's neck and cut off the excess strap, allowing for growth. The collar works only when worn continuously; it is water-resistant, so the dog can be bathed without removing it.
